title: Evaluating Context Compaction on the Questions That Come Later
abstract: arXiv:2610.27301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents compact their context for the question at hand, but the compacted context must also serve questions that come later. We evaluate compaction on these later questions, using four corpora that annotate the evidence of several questions per text and recorded agent trajectories, and compare every method with random deletion at the same budget. On MultiRC, keeping the sentences that gpt-6-luna (through the OpenAI Decisions API) judges necessary for the current question raises its accuracy on that question by 11.4 points at 25% of the tokens. On the later questions, however, no method that selects sentences for the current question does detectably better than deleting sentences at random. Deleting words instead of sentences does better: LLMLingua-2, which ignores the question, beats random sentence deletion at the same token count by 12.5 points on the later MultiRC questions. It keeps about twice random deletion's share

translated_title: 评估上下文压缩对后续问题的效果
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体会针对当前问题压缩其上下文，但压缩后的上下文还必须服务于后续出现的问题。我们在这些后续问题上评估压缩效果，使用了四个语料库，这些语料库对每篇文本中多个问题的证据进行了标注，并记录了智能体轨迹，同时在相同预算下将每种方法与随机删除进行比较。在MultiRC数据集上，保留gpt-6-luna（通过OpenAI Decisions API）判断为当前问题所需的句子，可以在仅使用25% token的情况下，将该问题的准确率提高11.4个百分点。然而，在后续问题上，任何为当前问题选择句子的方法都没有明显优于随机删除句子。删除词语而非句子效果更好：忽略问题的LLMLingua-2在相同token数量下，在后续MultiRC问题上比随机句子删除高出12.5个百分点，它保留的内容份额约为随机删除的两倍。
tldr: 研究发现为当前问题挑选句子的压缩方法虽能提升当前问题的准确率，但在后续问题上并不优于随机删除，而与问题无关的词级压缩方法LLMLingua-2在后续问题上反而表现更佳，表明上下文压缩需要兼顾未来的问题。
en_tdlr: Evaluating context compaction on later questions shows that question-aware sentence selection only helps the current question, while question-agnostic word-level deletion (LLMLingua-2) beats random deletion by 12.5 points on later questions.
